data.one_liner: Flutter widgets and utilities for integrating Firebase Storage.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready‑made widgets such as UploadButton, StorageImage, and list/grid views to display and manage files in Firebase Storage. Includes helpers like PaginatedLoadingController for loading large collections.
use_when: You need quick UI for uploading, listing, or displaying files from Firebase Storage
You want cross‑platform widgets that handle progress and pagination out of the box
avoid_when: Your app does not use Firebase Storage or you prefer a custom storage solution
You need fine‑grained control over UI beyond what the provided widgets offer
strengths: Works on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS
weaknesses: Limited customization compared to building your own widgets
Requires recent FlutterFire versions and iOS Swift Package Manager setup
data.setup_notes: Add firebase_core, firebase_storage, firebase_ui_storage to pubspec; configure Firebase for each platform; on iOS/macOS enable Swift Package Manager and set minimum iOS 15/macOS 12; update Android minSdk to 24.
